data.name: The Falling Skies
data.detailed_description:
Feature List

Winners of 5 free keys will be selected soon in our Telegram channel 🎉

Stay tuned so you don’t miss the results and future giveaways!


About the Game

WARNING

This game may contain flashing lights and rapidly changing images that could trigger photosensitive epileptic seizures. Some individuals may experience seizures when exposed to certain light patterns or visual effects commonly found in video games. Even people who have never had seizures before may be unaware that they are susceptible to this condition.
Players are advised to exercise caution and ensure the game is experienced by an appropriate audience.

The Falling Skies is a bleak walking-simulator horror experience with survival elements.
You step into the role of a newly appointed forest ranger, sent to patrol a territory where the soil is soaked with blood and the trees remember unspeakable crimes.

■ Explore the cursed forest: Follow abandoned trails that lead to the sites of forgotten tragedies.
■ Search for traces of the past: The environment shifts and distorts, revealing terrifying details of what truly happened here.
■ Uncover the village’s secret: Solve puzzles and complete tasks to understand what force drove the villagers to slaughter one another.

Overview

Sector No. 7 — “Echo Station” has long been considered cursed.
Decades ago, in a village hidden deep within the forest, an inexplicable act of mass genocide occurred — in a single night the inhabitants turned on each other and wiped themselves out.

Since then, the forest has swallowed the crumbling houses, but the souls of the dead have never found peace. After a series of recent tourist disappearances, the authorities sealed the entire region off.

You arrive to begin your watch, expecting solitude.
But it quickly becomes clear that the forest is not empty. Time itself seems trapped in moments of suffering, while the landscape twists and shifts, forcing you to relive the sites of those brutal killings again and again.

The Falling Skies is a psychological horror experience focused on paranormal changes within the landscape and the crushing sense of guilt that seems to emanate from the very earth itself.

Features

• An atmosphere of overwhelming dread
Immerse yourself in a story where the line between reality and horrifying visions of the past slowly dissolves.

• Stunning visuals
Powered by Unreal Engine 5 with DLSS 3 support, the game captures the haunting beauty of the dead forest and the detailed remains of the abandoned village.

• “Echoes of the Past” mechanic
Gameplay unfolds through temporal loops. The forest will repeatedly reveal fragments of the night that doomed the village.

• An unpredictable threat
The evil that destroyed the settlement has not vanished. It constantly changes shape—blending into the environment or taking the forms of the genocide’s victims.

• Crafted suspense
We studied the most effective horror games about isolation and folkloric terror to create an experience that keeps players on edge until the very end.

data.short_description: The Falling Skies is a dark psychological horror walking simulator with survival elements. You play as a forest ranger patrolling a cursed forest where a village mysteriously destroyed itself in a single night. Explore abandoned paths and uncover the echoes of a tragic past.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Ukrainian

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600X / Intel Core i5-7600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Medium-High

  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 8GB / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060S 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High+
